metadata.title: Recon
metadata.description: Reconciliation of company books against the copy each authority holds, with cited legal basis.

overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: Recon compares your books with the copy each authority holds and lists where the sources disagree under a cited rule.
overview.notice: Findings state that sources disagree under a cited rule. They are not tax advice.

findingsCard.title: Findings
findingsCard.description: Disagreements between your books and an authority's copy, each with the rule it was checked under.
